Professional Summary
Senior Node.js developer with strong backend engineering focus, experienced in building scalable APIs, data pipelines and cloud-deployed services. Proven track record delivering production features, improving system performance and reducing operational overhead. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
Node.js, TS, Express.js, MongoDB, AWS, GraphQL, Redis, Docker, Git, Jira

Work Experience
Senior Node.js Developer, Wipro (Dec 2021 - Present)
- Developed microservices using Node.js, TS and Express.js, integrating MongoDB for primary data storage and AWS Lambda for event-driven processing, reducing API latency by 30%.
- Implemented GraphQL layer over existing REST endpoints and used Redis for caching hot queries, improving query response times and lowering DB read load.
- Designed CI/CD pipelines with Docker images and AWS ECS, automated deployments via Git workflows and Jira-driven release processes to achieve weekly release cadence.

Node.js Developer, Zentrix Labs (Sep 2019 - Nov 2021)
- Built and maintained backend services in Node.js with Express.js and TS, modeling documents in MongoDB to support multi-tenant product features and achieving 99.8% uptime.
- Containerized services with Docker and managed deployments on AWS EC2/Elastic Beanstalk; set up Redis for session management and caching to reduce DB hits.
- Integrated GraphQL endpoints for client apps, collaborated via Git and Jira to deliver cross-functional sprints and instrumented metrics for performance tuning.
